key_findings: s2c 0x00CC (new rank 1 s2c gap, 242 pcap hits) is an actor-record apply opcode - NOT a generic actor swap. It deserializes a large actor state record from the packet (param_3 is the packet body, indexed at offsets +0..+0x11+) and writes the fields into the local actor representation, with multiple conditional sub-fields gated by sentinel flags. Body size estimate: at least 0x14 bytes of header + variable Lua-typed payload.

So 0x00CC and 0x00D0 likely target the SAME 16-slot table - 0x00CC is the full actor-record reset that includes the table, while 0x00D0 is a smaller incremental update to just the table.

Alt-path gate check: FUN_00764630 uses Lua name matching to decide whether to clear the *(param_1+0xbc) gate flag. The gate is the entry-guard predicate FUN_004D8830 - so 0xCC has a two-shot pattern: first the alt path runs, then if the gate clears, the primary path runs on the next 0xCC. This is likely a synchronization handshake for actor-state transitions (e.g. zone-change settled, now apply the full actor record).
